text:
The response provides a basic word-counting skeleton using `collections.Counter`, which is relevant. However, it does not actually read all text files under a directory: it passes the string `'*.txt'` directly to `count_words`, which will attempt to open characters like `*` as filenames and fail. It also lacks directory traversal (`os.walk`/`glob`), file filtering, and basic text normalization. Overall, the program is not functional as requested.

Rating: [[2]]
